---
name: Learning or delivery task
about: Plan a lesson, integration, infrastructure or release task with evidence
title: "task: "
---

## Planning

Roadmap: #2. Record task ID, type, phase, priority and current status. Use the native board Status field instead once that board is configured.

## Desired outcome

What should the learner or system be able to do? State the completion target.

## Prerequisites and scope

Link required tasks and note blockers. Resolve specific account, cost and environment choices before any paid execution. Split a large task before implementation.

## Done when

- [ ] Observable result demonstrated
- [ ] Relevant checks and review completed
- [ ] Learner explanation and remaining limitations recorded where applicable

## Evidence

Link applicable branch, PR, CI, tool trace, image digest, environment and smoke checks. Record what the learner actually did. Keep secrets and private account details out.
